messages:
maya: quick status — bringing up babel17b (int4) on canary. p95 latency jumping from ~160ms to ~320ms under small bursts and i saw 3 OOMs yesterday. logs attached below.

sam: thanks — are these on the new batch window defaults? we rolled window_ms -> 30 last week.

maya: yep, canary uses batch_window_ms=30 and batch_max_tokens=4096. also default max_new_tokens=128. KV hit ratio looks fine but memory fragmentation seems to spike after a few minutes.

oli: curious — fragmentation + bursts often point at prefetch + soft-evict interaction. can you paste an OOM trace?

maya: paste from the canary run 1718804800:
```
OOM: device 0 failed alloc 1.2G at step 534
model: babel17b_int4
context: batch_size=6, tokens_per_batch ~ 180, max_new_tokens=128
mem_free before alloc: 800MB
KV cache mem: 4.1GB
slot_compactor: triggered 2x in last 2m
```

jules: two quick hypotheses: (1) batch window too large causing big microbatches that trigger internal alloc peaks, (2) max_new_tokens default too high for typical prompts — combine to push soft-evict into thrash.

sam: agree. try reducing batch_window_ms to 12-20 and lowering max_new_tokens default to 96 on canary. also enable soft-evict with a conservative threshold (kv_soft_evict_threshold=0.8) and track evict churn.

maya: ran a quick experiment with:
```
{"batch_window_ms": 18, "batch_max_tokens": 4096, "max_new_tokens_default": 96, "kv_soft_evict_threshold": 0.8, "prefetch_stride": 1}
```
result: p95 stabilized ~165ms, p99 ~420ms (down from p99 720ms), OOMs -> 0 over a 4h smoke. throughput ~same.

qa: nice! do you have numbers for OOM rate and error counts?

maya: earlier 24h canary: OOM rate ~0.9% of calls, error spikes aligned with 10-20rps bursts. after config change 4h: OOM rate 0/3600 calls. we should run 24h to be sure.

oli: also check that prefetch stride=1 doesn't increase KV churn for long dialogs. if dialogs >1024 tokens we might reintroduce frag. maybe add a progressive prefetch cap for sessions > 2k tokens.

jules: deployment checklist:
- run 24h A/B: control (window_ms=30,max_new=128) vs candidate (18,96)
- gather p50/p95/p99, OOM count, KV eviction events, compactor runs, latency regressions on tail
- tie to cost delta (token/sec, GPU utilization)

infra-bot: canary snapshot saved as snap-1718805200. alerting: added OOM counter metric babel17b.int4.oom_count.

sam: I can provision a 24h split-run tomorrow. who wants to own analysis?

maya: i'll take analysis (latency + mem charts). ola/oli can do kernel-level traces if we see weird allocator patterns. jules — can you draft rollout gating rules?

jules: yep — propose gating: p99 latency increase <10% AND OOM rate delta <= 0.01% AND KV_evictions_per_minute not > 2x. if all pass, promote canary to stable 50% then 100% over 6h windows.

qa: one more ask — add a regression eval on our 200 prompt set (focus on generation length) since reducing max_new_tokens can impact quality. i'll run eval and post diffs.

maya: good call. i'll add the test to the canary harness. postmortem if anything bad shows up. :thumbsup:

sam: awesome. timeline: start A/B tomorrow 09:00 PT, end ~09:00 PT+24h. owners: maya (analysis), sam (run), oli (alloc traces), jules (gating), qa (quality eval).

maya: thanks team — will post live links when metrics are streaming.
